lines.trans: Spinning the handle past three hundred sixty degrees is a technical foul.
Under tournament rules, this ball has to be replayed.
Three technical fouls — this match is officially canceled.
I thought throwing the game looked clumsy — the acting was way over the top.
Please settle the gentleman's tab on our way out.
Thank you for what? For giving me the chance to make money for your family's company?
Didn't you just watch me play a moment ago?
Back in university, I wanted practice organizing a live program.
So I put together an intercollegiate table-football tournament.
Then I figured out all the rules and practiced the techniques and tactics.
None of the campus players could beat me, so they complained it wasn't fun.
And that league never held a second tournament again.
